summary: Sandbach United are looking to maintain their position at the top of the table with a win against Cheadle Heath Nomads in this afternoon's fixture. The Bach will be hoping their supporters can provide an extra boost as they chase another three points in what promises to be a competitive encounter. Meanwhile, there's Premier Division recognition for the wider NWCFL with Connor Beard of Trafford winning the paxsport Goalkeeper of the Month award for August.
